title: Descendants of Israel and Judah

questions.question: How many sons did Israel (Jacob) have?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:1-2 (ESV): "These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher." (Count is 12)

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:3 (ESV): "The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah... Now Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the sight of the LORD, and he put him to death."

questions.question: Who bore Perez and Zerah to Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:4 (ESV): "His daughter-in-law Tamar also bore him Perez and Zerah..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Jesse?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:12 (ESV): "Boaz fathered Obed, Obed fathered Jesse."

questions.question: Who was the seventh son of Jesse?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:15 (ESV): "Ozem the sixth, David the seventh."

questions.question: What happened to Achar (Achan), the troubler of Israel?
options: He transgressed in the matter of the devoted thing
questions.correctAnswer: He transgressed in the matter of the devoted thing
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:7 (ESV): "The sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the matter of the devoted thing..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Bezalel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:20 (ESV): "Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel."

questions.question: Whom did Hezron marry at the age of sixty?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:21 (ESV): "Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Caleb (Chelubai)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:9, 18 (ESV): "The sons of Hezron... Caleb..." (Verse 18 explicitly calls him Caleb the son of Hezron).

questions.question: Who were the sisters of David?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:16 (ESV): "And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail."

questions.question: Who was the father of Amasa?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:17 (ESV): "Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite."

questions.question: What did Sheshan do because he had no sons?
options: He gave his daughter to Jarha his servant
questions.correctAnswer: He gave his daughter to Jarha his servant
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:34-35 (ESV): "Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters, but Sheshan had an Egyptian slave whose name was Jarha. So Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his slave as a wife..."

questions.question: Which son of Caleb founded Bethlehem?
Who were the scribes who lived at Jabez?
options: The Kenites who came from Hammath
questions.correctAnswer: The Kenites who came from Hammath
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:55 (ESV): "The families also of the scribes who lived at Jabez... These are the Kenites who came from Hammath..."

questions.question: Who died without children?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 2:30, 32 (ESV): "...but Seled died childless... and Jether died childless."

key_verse_text: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
